conviction_note: Small positive lean (p_up 55) on one primary-document inference: the metric Endesa guides on (Resultado Ordinario Neto, >EUR 2.4bn) excludes the EUR 208m restructuring provision under Endesa's own APM definition, while the one public Q3 preview (Jefferies, 19 Oct) argues the provision 'should prevent any increase' in guidance. With H1 ordinary net at EUR 1,480m (62% of the guide) and Jefferies' own adjusted Q3 at EUR 580m, 9M ordinary would be about EUR 2,060m, 86% of the floor. Against that, Endesa's habit at 9M is to reconfirm rather than raise, H1 already carried positive one-offs, and the stock is at an all-time high above every broker target. abs_move 3.2 is a large-cap utility scale with some room for a guide change. The findings sum to +0.7 and the scaled number is +0.32. Both are small and point the same way.

findings.finding: Under Endesa's APM definition, the guided metric (Resultado Ordinario Neto, guide >EUR 2.4bn) excludes the initial net provision for workforce restructuring plans, so the ~EUR 208m redundancy provision does not count against the guide. The only public Q3 preview (Jefferies) says the provision 'should prevent any increase' in guidance and puts FY26 EPS at 2.3 'due exclusively to the provision'. On H1 ordinary 1,480m plus Jefferies' own adjusted Q3 of 580m, 9M ordinary is ~2,060m, 86% of the guide floor with a quarter left, which makes a raise or 'well above' language more plausible than that preview assumes.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: H1 2026 guide raise (29 Jul 2026): stock up ~1.9% to EUR 41.02 per Investing.com via Parqet (baseline cadence history shows +3.30 on 2026-07-29). At 9M 2025 Endesa reconfirmed in the high range and the stock moved about +2% (baseline estimated date 2025-10-28; the actual release was 29 Oct). The baseline reaction history is a cadence estimate with misdated rows, so it is a scale only.
findings.original_quote: Resultado Ordinario Neto = Resultado Neto de la Sociedad Dominante - Resultado Neto en Ventas de Activos no Financieros (superiores a 10 millones de euros) - Pérdidas Netas por Deterioro de Activos no Financieros (superiores a 10 millones de euros) - Dotación Inicial Neta de Gastos de Personal por Planes de Reestructuración de Plantilla relativos... [Translation: ordinary net income = net income minus net gains on non-financial asset sales above EUR 10m, minus net impairment losses above EUR 10m, minus the initial net provision for workforce restructuring plans.] Jefferies via Bolsamanía: 'la provisión de reestructuración de 200 millones de euros debería impedir cualquier aumento de los beneficios... Prevemos un BPA para el ejercicio fiscal 2026 de 2,3 euros/acción, ligeramente por debajo de la previsión de la compañía de más de 2,4 euros/acción, debido exclusivamente a la provisión extraordinaria.' [Translation: the EUR 200m restructuring provision should prevent any earnings upgrade; we forecast FY26 EPS of EUR 2.3, slightly below the company's >EUR 2.4 guide, due exclusively to the extraordinary provision.]
findings.why_not_priced: The one broker preview in the Spanish press frames the provision as a cap on the guide, which suggests at least part of the sell-side expects a plain reconfirmation. If the market expected a raise, previews would be calling for one and the stock (at an all-time high of EUR 43.77, above Jefferies' EUR 37 target) would have run further into the print than +3.6% over 5 days. The run-up is consistent with either reading, which is why this is sized small.
findings.independence: The H1 deck itself said 'Ya se ha alcanzado más del 60% del objetivo de BPA para el año' (https://www.endesa.com/content/dam/enel-es/home/inversores/registrosoficiales/hechosrelevantes/documentos/2026/cnmv/1s/presentacionderesultados1s2026.pdf). Against it: the same deck says the H1 numbers 'incluyen efectos no recurrentes positivos', which lowers the H2 run-rate. Same company, a different document.

lessons_applied: 'A finding about a number the market has already been told is worth 0': the provision finding (public by OIR since 31 Jul) moved from -0.1 to 0.0 and the buyback finding (public weekly flow) from +0.1 to 0.0
'A verified fact is not a predicted reaction' plus the stock above all targets: the guidance finding moved from +0.8 to +0.6 and p_up from 56 to 55
'A beat made of a one-off is sold' (H1 included positive non-recurrings): p_up held near 50 rather than raised
'Macro-to-company transmission is a hypothesis': the pool-price finding moved from +0.2 to +0.1

'The move is in the guide' / 'too small about the move': abs_move_pct raised from 3.0 to 3.2 for the chance of a guide change; it was not raised toward the 7-9% cohort medians, because those were measured mostly on small caps and this is a 23-analyst large-cap utility
